label: No supply-closed collection of actual CONCRETE_6 is wholly borrowed
paraphrase: Open premise, analyst formulation, unattributed: at the selected world w, every collection of actual concreta that contains every candidate existing at w that grounds a member at w (concrete or not), and each of whose members is grounded by some candidate existing at w, is empty. The collection form of the borrowed-reality principle over all modelled actual suppliers of the selected direct relation; suppliers outside that relation are not modelled.
